note: How the sim's fx events become sound cues (audio/audio_cues.gd). Sounds, thresholds, scaling and grunt rules live here, not in code. Damage amounts are the sim's own: over three seeded 90 s matches the median hit was 29.5, the 75th percentile 74 and the 90th percentile 101, with beam hits up to about 300. Crater energy ran from 0.24 to 15.3 with a median of 2.6. 'fighters' maps a fighter's roster id (f.id) to its voice; the old ids (KAI, VORR) and the new ones (PROTAGONIST, RIVAL) both work.

grunts.note: Until damage events carry the region hit, the gesture is drawn from the pool; then it follows the region (head: pain.head, limbs and core: pain.limb).

flash.note: Head-flash cues (docs/art/flash-prototype-spec.md). Priority follows Art's rank: the surge outranks everything. Rendering calls AudioCues.flash(S, actor, id) when a flash starts, or emits a cosmetic flash event {actor, id}. The ranks are copied from Art's data/art/flashes.json (v2, updated to 13 active flashes). Held flashes (Primed: hiding was removed from the base game) keep their recipe but are not ranked, rendered or played.
